prompt:
Mandolin, eight string musical instrument. Isolated front view A-style teardrop wooden mandolin. Its wide headstock has 8 tuning buttons arranged in TWO COLUMNS BY FOUR ROWS, like this spatial layout: left upper and right upper, left upper-middle and right upper-middle, left lower-middle and right lower-middle, left bottom and right bottom. FOUR buttons ON EACH SIDE. Eight fine strings go to bridge in four close double pairs. Please carefully draw all FOUR rows of tuning buttons. Not a guitar. Plain body, no decoration.
Use only attached invidious.png as drawing-style reference. Thick rounded dark chocolate outlines, simple rounded 2D shapes, clean smooth solid color fills, few restrained flat shadow shapes. No watercolor, grain, mottling, speckles, paper texture, bleed, muddy patches or fuzzy edges. Transparent background, no ground or detached shadows. 512x512 PNG RGBA, no text.
en: A wooden mandolin has a teardrop body, short neck, and eight tuning buttons.
ja: しずく形の木製胴体と短い棹、八つの糸巻きがあるマンドリン。
